I m from Bonn Germany 
A country is far more than the worst moments you can find within it. Poverty, crime, social issues, and unusual behavior exist in every society, yet selectively presenting a few disturbing scenes as the “reality” of an entire nation is nothing but a biased narrative. Pakistan has its challenges, but it also has its beauty, diversity, culture, resilience, and countless ordinary people living meaningful lives. If the goal is truth, show the whole picture—not carefully selected fragments designed to provoke hatred and contempt.
